issues.title: [Problem] Streaming Euclidean MST to constant factor in space polylogarithmic in the number of points
issues.body:
<!-- atlas-problem:v1 parallel -->

### Problem statement

Goal: Design an $O(1)$-approximation insertion-only streaming algorithm for estimating the minimum spanning tree (MST) cost in the $d$-dimension Euclidean space using one pass and space $\mathrm{poly}(d\cdot \log n)$, where $n$ is the number of points in the stream. (The dimension $d$ can be assumed to be logarithmic in $n$.)
